text:
devin: thinking about adding an 'adaptive hysteresis' control to the fallback UX. idea: if a fallback fires, runtime applies a short cooldown (0-60s) before allowing primary again so we avoid oscillation. thoughts?

maria: huge yes. we see lots of flip-flop when traffic blips. need to make cooldown scope configurable: per-route, per-model, org-default.

sam: +1. defaults: cooldown=15s, decay factor so repeated fallbacks increase cooldown. show expected effect on p95 in the UI.

nina: UX: in rollout editor show a small graph preview of behavior with/without hysteresis and a toggle 'enable oscillation protection'. add a tooltip: 'prevents rapid fallback/restore loops'.

ops-bot: feature-flag update: adaptive_hysteresis_experiment enabled for 12% orgs

maria: telemetry fields to add: fallback_trigger, chosen_fallback_mode, cooldown_ms, fallback_count_window, tokens_saved, sampled_trace_id. include a 'hysteresis_reason' enum: spike, quota, model_error.

sam: audit plan: keep sampled traces 90d; replay UI should show timeline + both primary/fallback outputs side-by-side. raw output view gated via RBAC and requires SSO confirmation.

devin: API: propose header X-Redwood-Fallback-Info: mode=failfast;trigger=latency;cooldown=15000;trace=tr_abc when fallback happens. also optional body field fallback_meta when ?debug=1 and client authorized.

maria: also surface quota causes: if fallback due to per-customer dedicated-capacity throttle, header should include cause=quota and link to quota docs in console pill.

sam: sample curl for header check:

  curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -d '{"prompt":"test"}' \
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# response header: X-Redwood-Fallback-Info: mode=keep_trying;trigger=quota;cooldown=15000;trace=trc987

nina: console pill: short tag 'fell back (cooldown 15s)' with small popover showing why + button 'replay in sandbox'. sandbox replay mutes rate limits and marks results as replay-only.

devin: ops ask: add operator 'force-unlock' button with audit trail (who clicked, when). must be admin-only.

maria: sampling defaults? ops-bot suggests 0.2% org-wide and 5% for experiment cohort. agree to make configurable.

ops-bot: set sampling_rate=0.2% / experiment_cohort=5% (tag: adaptive_hysteresis)

sam: tests: unit for header emission, integration that simulates oscillation and verifies cooldown behavior, UI test for sandbox replay gating.
devin: docs: add explainer about hysteresis math (decay factor, backoff multiplier) and runbook snippet for operators on how to use force-unlock.
nina: also recommend an opt-in checkbox in rollout UI 'apply hysteresis only for latency triggers' so customers can avoid persistent error-based cooldowns.
maria: action items: 1) telemetry schema PR 2) API header spec + fallback_meta opt-in 3) console pill + sandbox replay work 4) RBAC + audit trail 5) flags/rollout plan 6) tests + docs
devin: i'll draft UI mock and open GH issues for these items. thanks everyone.

ops-bot: note: rollout flag will auto-instrument telemetry once enabled.
